motion.page_turn: framer-motion drag='x' with constraints, triggering onDragEnd to change page index. Transition: type='spring', stiffness=300, damping=30
motion.overlay_toggle: Animate top nav (y: '-100%' -> '0%') and bottom bar (y: '100%' -> '0%') with opacity 0 -> 1. duration: 0.3s ease-out
motion.context_menu: Scale up from transform origin at the tap location. Initial scale: 0.9, opacity: 0 -> scale: 1, opacity: 1, type: spring

PageContainer.description: Framer motion container managing the 604-page horizontal swipe logic. Tracks current page state.

MushafPage.description: Renders verses for a specific page. Maps over verses to render them continuously. Handles 'hidden verses' mode by toggling text opacity to 0 while keeping medallions visible.

SurahBanner.description: Ornate banner displayed at the beginning of a Surah on the page.

AyahText.description: Component for individual Ayah text. Renders the Uthmani text followed by the AyahMedallion. Detects double-tap to trigger ContextMenu.

TopNavigationBar.description: Glassmorphic top overlay toggled via single-tap. Contains hamburger menu, settings gear, and the Surah/Page/Juz info pill.

BottomAudioControls.description: Streamlined audio player overlay toggled via single-tap. Contains global playback controls, Recite Along, and Memorize mode.

PlayFAB.description: Large glowing green play button floating at the bottom right. Toggles global audio.

AyahContextMenu.description: Minimal, compact context menu triggered by double-tap on an Ayah. Absolutely positioned near the touch coordinates.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure your file paths correspond to .js files (not .tsx) as requested by the environment.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays like TopNav, BottomBar, or ContextMenus. Use solid dark backgrounds with blur (bg-[#0a0a0a]/90 backdrop-blur-2xl).
Render the Mushaf reading surface strictly to mimic real Madani pages. Use text-justify with inline ayahs. Shadcn UI cards are inappropriate for this specific reading view.
Use framer-motion extensively for swipe gestures across the 604 pages, as well as smoothly animating the entrance/exit of the single-tap controls overlay.
For 'Hidden Verses' mode, apply a CSS class or inline style that forces text color to transparent (text-transparent) while maintaining layout, but ensures the Ayah Medallions remain visible.
Double-tap interactions must use a custom hook or React event listener on the Ayah elements to calculate X/Y coordinates for spawning the compact ContextMenu.
Global playback state should be decoupled from the page so audio continues playing seamlessly when turning pages.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This breaks transforms. Always target specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e. do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component is located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
